description: Validation error code registry for Canonical Game Schema v1.0.0

errors.description: Required root or nested fields are missing per JSON Schema
errors.suggestion: Add all required fields defined in game-version-1.0.0.schema.json

errors.description: Field value type does not match JSON Schema
errors.suggestion: Correct the field type (string, integer, object, array, boolean)

errors.description: Enum value is not in the allowed set
errors.suggestion: Use a valid enum value from the schema or registry

errors.description: String value fails pattern constraint (symbol id, state id, machine id, contentHash)
errors.suggestion: Fix the identifier format per CANONICAL_GAME_SCHEMA_V1.md §3

errors.description: Integer value outside min/max bounds (grid size, counts, priorities)
errors.suggestion: Adjust value to fall within documented limits

errors.description: Unknown property at root level (additionalProperties false)
errors.suggestion: Move custom data into extensions namespace or remove the field

errors.description: schemaVersion major version is not supported
errors.suggestion: Set schemaVersion to 1.0.0 or migrate document to supported schema

errors.description: contentHash present but format is invalid
errors.suggestion: Use sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters

errors.description: State machine does not have exactly one initialStateId
errors.suggestion: Set a single initial state per machine

errors.description: session.rootMachineId does not reference an existing state machine
errors.suggestion: Set rootMachineId to a key in stateMachines

errors.description: Transition targetStateId does not exist in the same machine
errors.suggestion: Fix typo or add missing state

errors.description: Transition targetMachineId does not exist for spawn effect
errors.suggestion: Add machine definition or fix targetMachineId

errors.description: Orphan state is not reachable from initial state
errors.suggestion: Remove unused state or add incoming transition

errors.description: Non-terminal state has no outgoing path or progression to terminal
errors.suggestion: Add transitions or progression metadata

errors.description: Terminal state has invalid goto to non-terminal without exit path
errors.suggestion: Fix terminal state transitions

errors.description: Spawnable machine has no pop/exit path
errors.suggestion: Add FEATURE_COMPLETE transition with effect pop in child machine

errors.description: Computed max stack depth inconsistent with spawn graph
errors.suggestion: Review spawn chain and maxStackDepth

errors.description: maxStackDepth is less than computed worst-case depth
errors.suggestion: Increase session.maxStackDepth

errors.description: Infinite loop detected without progression counter metadata
errors.suggestion: Add progression block or fix transition cycle

errors.description: Worst-case spawn depth exceeds session.maxStackDepth
errors.suggestion: Reduce nesting or increase maxStackDepth

errors.description: Duplicate transition id within the same state
errors.suggestion: Use unique transition ids per state

errors.description: Duplicate state id within the same machine
errors.suggestion: Use unique state ids per machine

errors.description: Duplicate machine id in stateMachines map
errors.suggestion: Use unique machine ids

errors.description: Ambiguous transition priority for same trigger on same state
errors.suggestion: Adjust priority tiers or precedence.triggerOrder

errors.description: Multiple equally ranked transitions with no deterministic tie-break
errors.suggestion: Fix priority/precedence or transition ids

errors.description: state.pluginRefId does not resolve to plugins map entry
errors.suggestion: Add plugin reference or fix pluginRefId

errors.description: pluginConfig fails plugin JSON Schema validation
errors.suggestion: Fix config per packages/game-schema/schemas/plugins/*.schema.json

errors.description: Plugin capabilities do not satisfy stateType requirements
errors.suggestion: Use plugin with required capabilities or change stateType

errors.description: Symbol reference in paytable, reels, or triggers does not exist in symbols map
errors.suggestion: Add symbol definition or fix reference

errors.description: Reel set strip count does not match gameConfig.grid.reels
errors.suggestion: Add or remove reels to match grid size

errors.description: Exposure validation failed for configured validationMode (theoretical max exceeds cap in strict mode)
errors.suggestion: Raise maxWinMinorUnits/maxWinMultiplier or reduce paytable/feature awards

errors.description: Published document contentHash mismatch or unauthorized mutation
errors.suggestion: Create new draft game version instead of editing published snapshot

errors.description: state.rtpCategory is not registered in platform or document RTP registry
errors.suggestion: Use BASE, FREE_SPINS, HOLD_AND_WIN, MULTIPLIERS or extend rtpCategoryRegistry

errors.description: Conflicting RTP category decomposition definitions
errors.suggestion: Resolve overlapping categories in same decompositionGroup

errors.description: Transition priority or priorityTier not in priority-tiers-v1 registry
errors.suggestion: Use registered tier and matching defaultPriority from priority-tiers-v1.json

errors.description: Transition missing priorityTier on hand-authored graph
errors.suggestion: Add priorityTier from priority-tiers-v1.json

errors.description: Published game missing expected RTP categories for active features
errors.suggestion: Assign FREE_SPINS / HOLD_AND_WIN rtpCategory on feature states

errors.description: RTP category parent rollup graph contains a cycle
errors.suggestion: Remove cyclic parent links in rtpCategoryRegistry

errors.description: Declared exposure cap is unreachable but enforceCap is true
errors.suggestion: Lower paytable/feature awards or raise cap

errors.description: Exposure manual attestation used (validationMode manual)
errors.suggestion: Ensure attestation fields are complete and reviewed

errors.description: Spawn transition lacks resolvable pop path in target machine
errors.suggestion: Add pop transition on FEATURE_COMPLETE in child machine

errors.description: persistentStore schema present under mvp-v1 policy (not allowed in MVP)
errors.suggestion: Remove persistentStore schema until Phase 3

errors.description: Multiplier plugin scope session forbidden in MVP
errors.suggestion: Use scope feature_frame only

errors.description: runtimeLimits.maxFramesPerChain exceeds session.maxStackDepth
errors.suggestion: Align runtimeLimits with maxStackDepth

errors.description: Hold & Win worst-case respins exceed maxRespinsPerFeature
errors.suggestion: Reduce initialRespins/gridCapacity or raise runtime limit

errors.description: contentHash does not match canonical serialized document bytes
errors.suggestion: Recompute hash or reload correct snapshot

errors.description: Pinned plugin version not found in runtime registry
errors.suggestion: Install matching built-in plugin version or update game definition

errors.description: determinism fields not supported by engine version
errors.suggestion: Update engine or change determinism configuration

errors.description: Simulation attempted on draft without dev override
errors.suggestion: Publish game version or enable draft simulation in dev profile

errors.description: No valid ValidationReport with valid=true for this snapshot
errors.suggestion: Run validation engine and fix errors before simulation

errors.description: Golden mode contentHash does not match fixture manifest
errors.suggestion: Use pinned fixture game.canonical.json hash

errors.description: SimulationProfile references missing or invalid gameVersionContentHash
errors.suggestion: Set gameVersionContentHash to published snapshot hash

errors.description: spinCount must be >= 1
errors.suggestion: Increase spinCount

errors.description: golden mode spinCount does not match fixture manifest
errors.suggestion: Use spin count from tests/golden/manifest.yaml

errors.description: eventLog.maxEventsPerChain exceeds effective runtime limit
errors.suggestion: Lower maxEventsPerChain in profile or raise runtimeLimits

errors.description: determinism.engineVersion mismatch with worker
errors.suggestion: Pin engine version or upgrade worker
